segments.name: Chinese cuisine restaurant
products: food ingredients, soup bases and dipping sauces
segments.description: Operates Haidilao hot pot restaurants serving Chinese cuisine to guests in countries outside Greater China.
segments.evidence: We are a leading Chinese cuisine restaurant brand in the international market, operating Haidilao hot pot restaurant in the international market.

revenueModel.text: Dining guests pay the company for meals and service at its Haidilao hot pot restaurants outside Greater China.
revenueModel.evidence: Since 2023, we have accumulated over 88.6 million guest visits at our restaurants.

changes.text: In 2023 the group disposed of JAPAN HAI Co., Ltd, which held its hotel management and hot springs business in Japan.
changes.evidence: The disposal was completed on October 31, 2023, on which date control of JAPAN HAI Co., Ltd passed to the acquirer.
